label: Bible Study
prompt: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the _____, to go to Jesus.
verse: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
note: Peter steps out of the boat — the only disciple who tried walking on the water.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well _____.
verse: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
note: God is well pleased with a certain kind of sacrifice: doing good and sharing with others.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Be ye therefore _____ of God, as dear children;
verse: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
note: Modern versions say 'imitators' — Paul's picture is dear children copying the parent they love.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Being justified _____ by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verse: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
note: 'Freely' is the same Greek word Jesus uses for being hated 'without a cause' — grace with no reason in us.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Rest in the LORD, and wait _____ for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verse: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
note: 'Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him' — Psalm 37 says 'fret not thyself' three times (verses 1, 7, and 8).
